name: Fleurdelys
source:
One of the familiars of the deceased January Magician. Fleurdelys was made to be the perfect knight. A straight arrow who sees the world in black and white, Fleurdelys is a knight in the purest sense. He wishes only for the health and happiness of his liege, even if it means abandoning the rest of the world.

Somewhat impatient and brash yet chivalrous, Fleurdelys is surprisingly strong mentally. Ever since the war against the Demon Lord ended hundreds of years ago with the January Magician's death and Charlie's disappearance, he's been all alone in the January world.

Once he sees Jeanne, he seems shocked, even to the brink of tears...

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12640478.fleurdelys]official bio[/url]]
